data.desc: Globus is an integrated dry bulk shipping company that provides marine transportation services worldwide and presently owns, operates and manages a fleet of eleven dry bulk vessels that transport iron ore, coal, grain, steel products, cement, alumina and other dry bulk cargoes internationally. Globus' subsidiaries own and operate eleven vessels with a total carrying capacity of approximately 808,622 DWT and a weighted average age of about 7.5 years as of November 12, 2026.
